decision.explanation: The mapped NUnit test is enabled and contains substantive assertions covering real configuration cloning and isolation, asset identities, additive scene lifecycle, geometry/animation references, all ten prefab/control sets, usable instance fonts, persistence observations, adapter behavior and owned-resource cleanup. Cycle-68 null handling preserves non-null identity checks and permits absent assets only for vehicle-none. No game outcomes are fabricated. Binding assertions appropriately remain expected Red against the supplied shell stubs. This validates test preparation only; compilation, execution and human acceptance are not established.

All eight named tests are active, acceptance-mapped and contain substantive behavioral assertions; none are disabled or vacuous. Story_L1_05 now pointer-clicks Start and verifies actual matching queue membership, the preselected nondefault tier and unchanged account selection, while retaining geometry, hit-shape and navigation checks. The v68 reconciliation supersedes the frozen historical map's contradictory Start description. This is source-based test-preparation validity only, not proof of execution or human acceptance.

All four named tests are enabled and contain substantive, mapped assertions covering viewport/safe-area geometry and popup ordering, VVMP routing and storage constraints, shared unread acquisition/application and live badge updates, and account-isolated preference restoration. Recording adapters observe actual calls without manufacturing business outcomes. Story_NFR_03 correctly checks parsed marquee content for both the delivered own-42 message and its actual author's display name. No disabled or vacuous tests were found. This is source-based test-preparation validity only; fresh compilation/Red execution remains required, and no human acceptance is granted.
